'''Junn Gobint''' was a post-fledgling [[Mythrol]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Resistance]], managing consumables replenishment for [[starfighter]]s at their [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. He was also an amateur chemist, concocting new additives to extend [[fuel]] supplies and experimenting with alternative power sources.

In [[35 ABY]], he witnessed acting [[General]]s [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Finn]] receive transmissions from their ally [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] that left a trail for them to follow through the [[Unknown Regions]] to the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. The [[Resistance navy|forces]] of the Resistance then scrambled to [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] the [[Sith Eternal]] based there.

==Biography==
Junn Gobint was a [[Mythrol]] who served the [[Resistance]] during the post-fledgling stage of his life. During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the Resistance and the [[First Order]], Gobint was part of the group of Resistance members who set up [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. He was responsible for managing the replenishment of consumables for the [[starship]]s of the [[Resistance Starfighter Corps]] [[pilot]]s stationed at the base. He concocted new additives to extend [[fuel]] supplies and experimented with alternative power sources.<ref name="TROS VD" />

[[File:Junn_Gobint_C-3PO.png|thumb|left|250px|Gobint witnessed C-3PO that there was a message from Luke Skywalker's old X-wing starfighter.]]
In [[35 ABY]], he was present in the base shortly after the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' returned to [[Ajan Kloss]] from the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]]. Gobint was carrying a hose through the base when acting [[General]]s [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Finn]] and head [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Rose Tico]] began examining data from the [[droid]] [[D-O]]. When the droids [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] interrupted, Gobint and several other Resistance members began gathering round the group to see what the commotion was.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

After R2 revealed that he was receiving a message from [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]'s old [[X-wing starfighter]], the Mythrol watched as Finn analyzed the transmission and realized it was their ally [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] leaving them a trail to locate the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] in the [[Unknown Regions]]. With this information, the Resistance scrambled its [[Resistance navy|forces]] to [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] the forces of the [[Sith Eternal]] on Exegol.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Junn Gobint was an amateur chemist and carefully catalogued each [[Liter|milliliter]] of liquid metal [[rippinnium]] and each vial of [[coaxium]] in the Resistance's stores. He chastised any pilots who used more resources on an assignment then they had been allotted. Gobint had [[Color|blue]] skin with red markings.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
He wore a yellow [[Clothing|jumpsuit]] with brown [[boot]]s and [[glove]]s and a white [[belt]]. On base he made use of a reinforced sleeve refueling hose with a filter port.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Junn_Gobint_Makeup.png|thumb|right|Jeff Garlin spent four hours in makeup to become Junn Gobint.|200px]]
Junn Gobint was portrayed by comedian [[Jeff Garlin]]<ref name="Conan">{{YouTube|channel=channel/UCi7GJNg51C3jgmYTUwqoUXA|name=Team Coco|video=cp6RH_TMwcs|text=Jeff Garlin On His Very Small Role In "The Rise Of Skywalker" - CONAN on TBS|date=2020-02-07}}</ref> in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Garlin, a friend of director [[J.J. Abrams]], filmed in London and spent four hours in makeup for the role.<ref name="Conan" />
